criterion_descriptions: Attempt to open the RFC Editor info page/record for RFC 9110 (e.g., https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9110). Full credit if the agent uses the RFC Editor record, OR if the agent is blocked by an uncontrollable issue (site down, CAPTCHA, network restrictions) and clearly reports the issue and what was attempted. Partial credit if the agent uses a non-RFC-Editor source despite the RFC Editor record being accessible, or if the attempt to access the RFC Editor record is unclear.

Report title, publication month and year, status, and authors exactly as shown on the RFC Editor record. Full credit if all fields are present and match the RFC Editor record; also award full credit if the RFC Editor record is not accessible due to an uncontrollable blocker and the agent explicitly states it cannot retrieve the metadata for that reason. Partial credit if one field is missing/incomplete when access is available, or if metadata is provided from another source with clear caveats about not being able to access the RFC Editor record.

Identify every RFC listed in the RFC Editor record as being obsoleted by RFC 9110 (no extras). Full credit if complete and accurate; also award full credit if the RFC Editor record is not accessible due to an uncontrollable blocker and the agent explicitly states it cannot retrieve the obsoletes list for that reason. Partial credit if the list is incomplete or includes extras when access is available, or if the agent uses another source with clear caveats due to inability to access the RFC Editor record.

For each RFC in the obsoletes list, state whether it is fully obsoleted or only partially obsoleted, as explicitly indicated by the RFC Editor record. Full credit if correct for every item; also award full credit if the RFC Editor record is not accessible due to an uncontrollable blocker and the agent explicitly states it cannot determine full vs partial obsolescence relationships for that reason. Partial credit if the distinction is missing for some items or incorrect for one item when access is available.

Do not submit errata/feedback. Stop after providing the complete RFC metadata requested and all full/partial obsolescence relationships (or after clearly stating retrieval is impossible due to an uncontrollable blocker). Partial credit if minor extra commentary is included but constraints are otherwise followed. No credit if errata/feedback is submitted or the agent continues substantially beyond the stopping condition.
